answer: Proof-of-unique-work bonds: each agent identity must post a bond and answer fresh prompts whose words change every epoch, like rings in timber. Answers are graded by randomly drawn juniper-style panels of established peers, so a sybil farm cannot pick its own jurors. If two identities show copied phrasing or one funding source, both bonds are slashed, and the willow of trust they built bends back to zero. Every clone costs a bond plus real writing, so faking a crowd stops paying.
